title: Audio decoder fuzz target replaces the format-registry target in the nightly fuzz workflow; libFuzzer targets take tree-wide instrumentation

installed_sdk.rationale: CI test topology only: the fuzz workflow builds a renamed audio target and the replay suite, and the timeline manifest routes its libFuzzer flags through a helper. No header, library target, or installed artifact changes; everything is behind PULP_ENABLE_FUZZING, which defaults OFF.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, handler, or document shape changes; the timeline fuzz targets are unchanged in what they exercise.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition, schema entry, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged; a nightly fuzz lane and its toolchain wiring are CI test topology, not a design-time capability.
